 "anyOf": [

 "Consent.BusinessRuleViolation",

 "JWS.Malformed",

 "JWS.InvalidHeader",
 "JWE.DecryptionError",
 "JWE.InvalidHeader",

 "GenericError",
 "Event.UnexpectedEvent",
 "Body.InvalidFormat",
 "Resource.InvalidFormat"
 ]
 },
 {
 "pattern": "^[A-Za-z]+\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$"
 }
 ]
}
